source.why_installed_revision: The documented Kiln-compatible pin. Upstream main adds a tests/bin patchgate-eval control test (changed_and_replaced_controls_fail_after_open) that fails on this host filesystem as well as in the Nix sandbox, so main does not build here.

installation.command: nix profile install --impure --option builders '' --option secret-key-files '' --expr 'let pkgs = import (builtins.getFlake "nixpkgs") { }; in import /tmp/patchgate-97c1216f/nix/package.nix { inherit pkgs; }'

run.repository: /tmp/patchgate-demo (disposable Pijul repository, throwaway identity, XDG_CONFIG_HOME isolated to /tmp)
run.reason: The change touches only documentation paths (docs/guide.md). Deterministic secret checks and the trusted Nix checks apply, and the model does not review it.

records.reason: The change touches only documentation paths (docs/guide.md). Deterministic secret checks and the trusted Nix checks apply, and the model does not review it.

observations: A real Patchgate binary built from source and installed into the user Nix profile runs against a real Pijul repository.
The docs-only deterministic path accepted the change with zero model requests, which is why no model endpoint was needed.
The native report keeps authorizes_acceptance=false and an empty provenance.requests vector.
limits: This is a native Patchgate report, not a Kiln receipt. No kiln.patchgate.review.v1 receipt was produced: that requires a PatchgateProfile with exact executable/config identities, initial channel states and an intent, which is a separate operator step.
Patchgate main does not build on this host because of the failing eval control test; this run used the documented pin.
Nothing was merged into any real repository: the demo repository is disposable and review ran with --dry-run.
non_claims: A native accepted decision in a disposable repository is not CI acceptance, merge authority, source trust or release readiness, and it is not displayed anywhere in the live workspace yet.
